The problem 01 / 06

Most productivity advice was built for brains that already work the "normal" way.

Color-coded planners. Five-a.m. routines. Apps that need their own onboarding before they help you do anything. For a lot of us, that's not a system — it's another thing to fail at.

SKIP THE
NONSENSE
— the only rule we kept
What we do instead 02 / 06

One next step. Sent to a place you already check.

01

It lives in WhatsApp

No new login, no home-screen guilt. Support shows up in the chat app you open forty times a day already.

02

Protocols, not lectures

Short, do-able steps for money, planning, burnout and the rest — written to be followed on a low-capacity day.

03

Start with one thing

Pick the area that's loudest right now. No giant life-overhaul required to get a single useful win.
